title: TaskCommand
responsibility: Audits the declared coding or planning task through the shared completion service and renders its persisted result.

inputs.name: TaskCommand.constructor.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root used to read the selected loop state and resolve committed task evidence and audit storage. If omitted, the constructor uses process.cwd().

inputs.name: TaskCommand.run.flags
inputs.description: CLI values for kind (coding or planning), goal, committed project-relative plan path, loop name, comma-separated unit IDs, and JSON rendering. TaskCommand.run ignores json, splits units on commas, trims entries and removes empty entries; with loop, stored loop data supplies goal and completion kind/plan.

examples.goal: Audit task completion for the evidence grid

inputs.name: registerTaskCommand.program
inputs.description: Commander program that receives the task command, its check subcommand, and the module-task subcommands. Calling the check handler later prints the audit and sets the process exit code to one when passed is false.

inputs.name: renderTaskAudit.audit
inputs.description: TaskAudit record supplying passed, each check id/passed/detail, limitation, and audit id to the formatter. Other TaskAudit fields are not read by this function.

checks.detail: Commit the task source and preserve unrelated edits before its completion audit.

examples.limitation: Structural and evidence heuristics cannot prove arbitrary semantic correctness; review acceptance criteria and remaining uncertainty.

outputs.name: TaskCommand.run
outputs.description: Resolves to the TaskAudit returned by TaskCompletionService.check, including its checks and audit-record ID. When loop is supplied, stored loop data supplies the goal and completion kind/plan; units still come from the flags.

checks.detail: Commit the task source and preserve unrelated edits before its completion audit.

examples.limitation: Structural and evidence heuristics cannot prove arbitrary semantic correctness; review acceptance criteria and remaining uncertainty.

outputs.name: registerTaskCommand
outputs.description: Registers the task command, its check subcommand, and the module-task subcommands. The check action prints JSON when --json is set and otherwise renders text, then sets process.exitCode to one for a failed audit.

outputs.name: renderTaskAudit
outputs.description: One newline-separated string containing the audit outcome, each check, the limitation, and audit ID.
examples:
Task completion audit: failed
[failed] evidence: Commit the task source and preserve unrelated edits before its completion audit.
Structural and evidence heuristics cannot prove arbitrary semantic correctness; review acceptance criteria and remaining uncertainty.
Audit: 4bfc9726aabc0684d228bc0d0edc722078d723af132f52c5f86ab8a3249546af

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when a loop name is not lowercase kebab-case, or when the selected loop file is missing or fails the loop-state schema.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: The run promise rejects if readLoop cannot parse the selected loop file as JSON, because readLoop rethrows the JSON.parse error.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A filesystem failure other than a missing loop file is rethrown while loading loop state, and failures creating or writing the audit record reject TaskCompletionService.check.
